evidence.title: Maps do not show link between coronavirus and 5G wireless
evidence.snippet_en: AP News rated as false the claim that maps show a correlation between confirmed COVID-19 cases and where 5G wireless service has been installed.

evidence.title: No, 5G 'radiation' has NOT caused the second wave of COVID-19 in ...
evidence.snippet_en: Alt News rated as false the claim that 5G radiation is the cause behind the second wave of coronavirus pandemic in India.

evidence.title: Experts dismiss claims that 5G wireless technology created the ...
evidence.snippet_en: AFP Fact Check rated as false the claim that coronavirus is a result of 5G.

evidence.title: 'Kraken' Covid-19 subvariant linked to baseless claims about 5G ...
evidence.snippet_en: Full Fact states there is no evidence that 5G technology is harmful to human health, contradicting the claim that 5G waves are harming and killing people.
evidence.rating_text: There is no evidence that 5G technology is harmful to human health. The name ‘Kraken’ was chosen by a Canadian biology professor in an effort to make it easier to distinguish between different subvariants.

evidence.title: Fresh false claims about COVID-19 vaccine and 5G technology ...
evidence.snippet_en: AFP Fact Check rated as false the claim that COVID-19 means 'certificate of vaccination identity' and that 5G weakens the immune system.

evidence.title: 5G is not accelerating the spread of the new coronavirus – Full Fact
evidence.snippet_en: Full Fact rated as not true the claim that 5G WiFi networks could be responsible for the rapid spread of the new coronavirus.
evidence.rating_text: This is not true. There is no evidence that 5G WiFi networks are linked to the new coronavirus.

outputs.notes_en: The fact checks consistently contradict the claim that 5G is responsible for spreading the coronavirus or increasing cases. They address various aspects of this conspiracy theory, including the link between 5G and COVID-19 cases, 5G radiation causing the pandemic, and 5G weakening the immune system.
